title: Download File
summary: Native file download or application-owned file preparation action.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

full-width.description: The row fills its container, the look it had before 1.5.0; without it the row is as wide as its text, up to the container (decision C51), as sf-button's full-width.

file-name.description: The file's visible name and the name it is saved under. Empty: the link's last part, else «Файл» in the page's language.

file-size.description: The size as text, in the page's units («2,4 МБ»). A screen reader hears it with the unit in words («2,4 мегабайта»). Empty with an href to this page's own server: asked with one HEAD request and written in the page's language; any other address (another origin, data:, blob:) is not asked -- give the size.

file-type.description: The file's type in words (PDF, XLSX), shown before the size: «PDF · 2,4 МБ» (decision C25). Never in file-size.

icon.description: Former way to name the file's type by a glyph, which took the download sign's place (decision C25): give the type in file-type. Still drawn and noted in SF.deprecations until 2027-01-01.

href.description: Real resource destination; renders a native anchor when enabled.

download.description: Kept for compatibility: a file link downloads in the same tab whether or not it is given (decision C25); only target="_blank" opens a tab instead.

disabled.description: Render a disabled button with no live destination.

state.description: ready: the file can be fetched. preparing: the application is making it -- the spinner in the sign's place (the progress ring with value), «Готовим файл…» or «Готовим… 45 %», aria-busy, a press is ignored, «Отменить» beside it while cancelable; the start is said. When the host sets ready again with an href, the file a person pressed for is fetched by itself if it came within 10 s and the page is in sight, else the row says «Готово» and offers «Скачать» (decision C51); the end is said. error: it could not be made -- the row shows the error sign and border, «Не удалось собрать» and «Повторить» at its end, error-text small under it; the error is said at once.

error-text.description: Why the file could not be made and what happens next, a small line under the row in the error state («Сервер не ответил. Файл соберётся заново.»).

target.description: Where the link opens. Empty (default): the file downloads in the same tab. _blank: the file is opened to view in a new tab; the link shows the open-in-new sign and says «(откроется в новой вкладке)» to a screen reader (decision C25).

value.description: While preparing: the share made, per cent (0 to 100, clamped), drawn as the progress ring in the sign's place and «Готовим… 45 %» (decision C51). Absent: the spinner and «Готовим файл…».

cancelable.description: While preparing, «Отменить» stands beside the row; its press sends the cancelable cancel, and unless a listener prevents it the row is ready again (decision C51), as sf-progress-run's cancelable.

owner_semantics.application_action: no href renders a button; a press sends the cancelable request sf-file-download-request
owner_semantics.disabled: disabled button with no live destination
owner_semantics.preparing: state preparing: spinner (or the progress ring with value) in the sign's place, aria-busy, presses ignored, «Отменить» with cancelable; ready again with an href fetches the file by itself within 10 s on a page in sight, else offers «Скачать»
owner_semantics.error: state error: the row shows the error with «Повторить» at its end; its press sends retry

compatibility.size_lookup: an empty size preserves the existing Content-Length lookup

sf-file-download-request.summary: A person pressed the file: the request to fetch it (sf-file-download-request), cancelable. A page that cancels it takes the download over; to prepare the file it sets state="preparing" (value as it goes), then ready with the href, or error. Its former name sf-file-download-download doubled the word (decision C51) and is a dated alias until 2027-01-01.

sf-file-download-retry.summary: A person pressed «Повторить» in a row that could not be made (vocabulary §5 retry): the host prepares it again and sets the state; the file is fetched when it is ready, as after the first press.

sf-file-download-cancel.summary: A person pressed «Отменить» beside a file being made (vocabulary §5 cancel, cancelable): the host stops the work. Unless a listener prevents it the row is ready again at once; a host that prevents it sets ready itself. Either way the cancel is said.

sf-download-file:click.summary: Emitted once for an enabled native destination or application-owned action, from the rendered .sf-download-file root; bubbles to the host, is not composed and not cancelable.

accessibility.focus: Keep visible focus on the active control.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-file-download for one downloadable resource or an application-owned file preparation action.
do_not: Do not use a button when a stable resource href already exists
Do not leave href on an unavailable file
Do not use the decorative icon as the accessible name
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not put the file type in file-size or in icon: give it in file-type
Do not leave file-size empty for a file on another server, a data: or a blob: address: give the size
Do not fire several downloads at once for several files: offer one archive
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-file-download file-name="Отчёт за октябрь.pdf" file-type="PDF" file-size="2,4 МБ" href="/files/report.pdf"></sf-file-download>
